title: jired log result
description: What happened, newest first: one issue's history, or the whole workspace's. A field change, a comment posted or time booked, told apart by `kind`

scope.description: `issue` when an issue was named, `workspace` when the log covers every issue

key.description: The issue asked for; null when the log covers the whole workspace
The issue this entry belongs to

kind.description: `change` is a field the changelog recorded, `comment` a comment posted, `worklog` time booked. A comment and a worklog carry `text`; only a `change` carries `items`

summary.description: The issue's summary as the snapshot has it now, not as it read when this happened; empty when there is no snapshot to read it from

text.description: A comment's body, or the note a worklog was booked with, as markdown. Whole and undiffed: the terminal renders a diff, the record keeps the text

time_spent.description: A worklog's duration as Jira spells it — `2h 30m`

items.description: The fields a `change` touched, with both values whole; empty for a comment or a worklog
